description:
Macro Deck transforms your phone, tablet, or any device equipped with a modern internet browser into an efficient remote macro pad. With this tool, you can execute single or multi-step actions seamlessly with just a single tap.


What's Changed
🐞 Bug Fixes
- Show badge links and dark variants in Store descriptions instead of raw HTML by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1692
- Prevent Server Started steps failing on System, Http, Keyboard and Mouse by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1695
- Restore folder views and screensavers when their provider returns late by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1696
- Fix plugin inputs that could not be cleared by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1699
- Keep MCP deletions undoable after later changes by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1700
- Fix Home Assistant Set Light failing with a color temperature by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1733
- Fix Linux notifications whose title or message starts with a dash by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1729
- Run every line of a multi-line command on Windows by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1738
- Type line breaks as the Enter key on Windows and macOS by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1752
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/compare/v3.0.1...v3.0.2
